title: SendGrid template shows & or ' instead of the ampersand or apostrophe
symptoms: Apostrophes render as ' in the subject line
Node SDK logs Content with characters ', " or & may need to be escaped with three brackets
cause: Double-brace Handlebars expressions HTML-escape their values, which is visible in subject lines and in values that already contain markup. Triple braces insert the value raw.
fix: Use triple braces for values that may contain ampersands, quotes, or trusted HTML, and keep double braces for untrusted user text in the body.
affected: SendGrid dynamic templates, @sendgrid/mail 6.x to 8.x warning, as of 2026-10
